items.text: I live at Lydian Apartment owned by the Holland Partners Group since July 22, 2022. I put in my 30 day notice on October 22, 2023. On Oct 18, 2023, ****** sent out a rent/utility statement totaling $3,152.74. I created a cashiers check and gave the property staff the check on November 1st. It came to my attention that the apartment charged me for a full month of rent for November instead of a prorated amount up to November 22nd, my lease end date. I emailed the property manager, who confirmed that I overpaid an amount of $814.20. I requested for them to refund the amount, but they said they will hold onto it until my move out date. On the rental agreement, they only have permission to hold onto my security deposit, however, theyre now also withholding the money I overpaid on rent.

responses.text:
We have reviewed this account and, as a courtesy, have reversed the cleaning and damage charges.  The collections agency has been notified of this reversal and will take the appropriate actions.  We apologize for any miscommunication and are glad to have this matter resolved. 

Thank you,

Lydian Management

items.text: I reached out to the business via Email to follow up on getting back my $600 deposit, 38 days after moving out of my apartment (#***) at Lydian in *******. Instead of receiving my deposit the leasing company provided a billing statement claiming I owed close to $800 for cleaning, late fees, and other miscellaneous charges. 1. This  statement was not provided within the 21 days according ********** tenant laws, therefore I do not owe them anything. 2. I have video proof and receipts that the apartment was left spotless and in good condition enough to receive my deposit back.  3. A breakdown of what my deposit was used for was never provided. 4. How was I charged a late fee for this statement which I didn't know I owed and wouldn't have know if I hadn't reached out to them. And, for a statement that legally they are not owed due providing it well past the 21-day deadline. The company sent my account to a collection agency and my credit score dropped 40 points due to this!I tried contacting them to resolve this many times and they insisted I owed this money, which I do not. I lived at Holland Residential apartments for close to 30-months (Lydian in ******* and Alchemy in *************). Every single time, I paid my rent and utilities to YesManagement on time, every time. This is indicative that I have been a responsible tenant the entire time I resided there.  I would like for them to remove this $800 charge from my credit report and have my $600 deposit returned to **** feel that the company directly targets certain individuals (from low to moderate income) because the leasing company knows that we legally cannot do much about a statement like this. If the leasing company says we owe something, we have to pay it, or we risk being sent to collections as they did to me, even when they know these charges are false. I would like their business practices to be looked at very closely, they are scamming many people, not just me.
